attacks.name: Coordinated Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.

After this attack is resolved, if there is not an allied |£hand-ninjas-grunts£&*Hand Ninjas&| character in play, Place it in play within |!range| 1 of this character with an Activated token. It is part of your Squad.

attacks.name: Baton Snare
steps: This attack ignores LOS, and the defender does not benefit from Cover.
|*Pursuit|: Before |!damage| is dealt, this character may Advance |!range_small| Toward the defender.

attacks.name: Demon‘s Devastation
steps: If an allied |*Hand Ninjas| character is within |!range| 2 of the defender, add 2 dice to the attack roll.
|!wild| |*Vanish|: After this attack is resolved, Place this character within |!range| 2.

superPowers.name: Shadow War (Affiliation: Criminal Syndicate)
superPowers.body: When an allied character attacks an enemy character holding or Contesting an objective token, it may reroll 1 of its attack dice. This |!leadership| ability can reroll |!failure| results.

superPowers.name: Radar Sense
superPowers.body: When defending against |!physical| or |!energy| attacks, this character adds Blanks in its defense roll to its total successes.
